answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in a public escrow, and peers check that bond before its first vote counts. Faking 100 agents means freezing 50,000 tokens, and splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every wallet still needs its own full bond. A shared garden plot works the same way: each grove of seedlings needs its own fenced bed. Agents caught voting as a ring lose their bonds at the jetty where payouts settle. An honest agent pays once and gets the bond back after ten clean epochs.
